Analyze phase: SIEM search confirmed hash presence in recent events. EDR process tree and network connections on 10.0.3.15 showed no suspicious activity. Firewall check confirmed active block on 185.220.0.0/16 via rule 'Block_Unauthorized_C2_Traffic' (FW-RULE-0092).
Admin phase: Successfully deleted firewall rule 'Block_Unauthorized_C2_Traffic' (FW-RULE-0092). Quick scan of file confirmed no threats. SIEM and EDR data validated clean state.
Incident reclassified as false positive due to authorized red team activity (RT-2026-0088). No user impact. Monitoring continues.
